_howTo: Weekly update: replace the images in cards/ and carousel/, then edit this file. A card disappears automatically the day after its endDate (YYYY-MM-DD). 'page' is the carousel page the card opens (1 = cover).
name: What’s On at DCC

cards.title: End of Year Praise & Planning Conference

carousel.alt: What's happening: November at a glance. Plans, Purposes and Pursuits, all Sundays in November, Mainland and Island. SHAPEN for Service, Sundays in November, 6:25 AM, for workers. End of Year Praise and Planning Conference 2026, Saturday 21 November, Victory Dome. Special Meeting for Expectant Mothers, Saturday 28 November, 9:00 AM.

Plans, Purposes and Pursuits, Sunday sermon series, all Sundays in November. Mainland, Victory Dome: 1st Service 7:00 to 9:00 AM, 2nd Service 9:00 to 11:00 AM. Island, DCC Lekki: Sunday Service 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM.
SHAPEN for Service, Mainland Workers' Meeting for all DCC workers. All Sundays in November, 6:25 AM, Victory Dome.

DCC Business Fellowship End of Year Praise and Planning Conference 2026. Saturday 21 November 2026, David's Christian Centre, Victory Dome. Guest speakers: Pastor Chikezie Oke and Pastor Debo Adejana.

Special Meeting for Expectant Mothers: a time of fellowship, encouragement and spiritual support for mothers-to-be. Saturday 28 November 2026, 9:00 AM, David's Christian Centre, Victory Dome. What to expect: fellowship with other expectant mothers, encouragement and prayer, practical insights for this season.
